# 📝 Change Description

## 🎯 Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete failure/use case and what now happens.

## 🧱 Affected stages

List source/API/config/compiler/backend/package/docs areas changed and any compatibility impact.

## 🧪 Validation

Record actual commands/results. Distinguish checks run locally from CI/device checks still pending.

## 📚 Documentation and roadmap

- [ ] Relevant user/developer examples and references match behavior.
- [ ] Roadmap/changelog status reflects implemented work and evidence.
- [ ] No private keys, generated APKs, environments or caches are included.

## 🚧 Remaining limits

Describe unresolved behavior, untested platforms or deliberate limitations.
